$schema_comment_: Materialised by gan-fix-planner (manual mode, multi-MB carve-out) at Phase 1; consumed by gan-fix-generator and gan-fix-evaluator every iteration. Sticky issue IDs follow GAN-FEATURE-SHARED.md "Issue ID convention" — manual mode allocates fresh MB-NNN-01 ids (NNN = critique-stanza index, 01 = manual seed iteration). All 7 items are pinned (no fix_options enumeration in any stanza); no user-confirmation gate.

queue.symptom: Track-band and track-row CSS reference an undefined token namespace: var(--fg-default), var(--fg-muted), var(--fg-subtle), var(--surface-raised), var(--surface-overlay), var(--weight-semibold), var(--weight-medium), var(--radius-sm), var(--transition-fast). None of these are defined in src/common/styles/. In dark mode the track-row label colours fall through to inherited text, the zebra surface-raised background is a transparent no-op, and the FE/BE/QA tone differentiation collapses to a near-uniform.
queue.root_cause: Author wrote against an imagined token namespace (likely cribbed from a different design system) without auditing src/common/styles/tokens.css. 18+ undefined-token references currently leak through with no fallback values.
queue.change: Rename every undefined-token reference to existing project tokens — preferred mapping: --fg-default → --text, --fg-muted → --text-muted, --fg-subtle → --text-dim (or whatever the actual canonical names are; generator MUST audit tokens.css before substituting), --surface-raised → --elevated (or --surface), --surface-overlay → --elevated, --weight-semibold → font-weight: 600, --weight-medium → font-weight: 500, --radius-sm → an existing --radius-* token if present (otherwise inline literal matching DESIGN.md), --transition-fast → an existing --transition-* token if present (otherwise inline literal). Prefer rename over adding new tokens; only ADD a token if 3+ reuse sites emerge in the audit. tokens.css MUST-NOT-touch is scoped to existing --state-* keys, so adding a NEW non-state token is permitted if justified.

queue.symptom: Line 77: `border-inline-start: 5px solid currentColor;` is the 'no side-stripe borders' anti-pattern banned in DESIGN.md. Detector flagged pattern=side-tab. The 5px coloured rail also adds zero info — scroll position is already telegraphed by GanttDateHeader.
queue.root_cause: 5px solid coloured border used as a structural rail. PLANNER NOTE: at the verified baseline SHA, line 77 lives inside `.gantt-timeline-scroller__today-chip-arrow` (a CSS triangle drawing the today-chip chevron) — NOT the gutter/scroll-zone seam the bug stanza describes. Generator MUST re-read the file, locate the actual side-stripe rule (if any) AND/OR repurpose the chevron without using a 5px solid border. The pinned fix-text language is preserved verbatim below.
queue.change: Drop the 5px border entirely. If the seam between gutter and scroll-zone needs articulation, use a 1px var(--border) hairline. (Generator interpretation: remove `border-inline-start: 5px solid currentColor` at line 77; if the chevron arrow needs preserving, redraw with a smaller token-faithful pattern such as a 4px-or-thinner border-image, an inline SVG glyph, or a color-mix-driven triangle. The detector observable is the absence of `border-inline-start: 5px` in this CSS file.)

queue.symptom: 12 visible controls + 1 tray on a single row; State filter alone fans out 6 chips at rest (lines 144-160 render an 'all' button + STATE_FILTER_ORDER chips inline). Violates the ≤4-visible-options-at-decision-point guideline. The S kbd cycle key only helps users who already know it exists.
queue.root_cause: State filter rendered as an always-visible chip group instead of a popover-gated control.
queue.change: Collapse the 6-chip State filter into a single 'State: <current>' segmented button that opens a popover with the chips, parity with the Legend tray pattern that already exists in this toolbar. Popover MUST be keyboard-navigable (Tab through chips, Enter/Space to select, Esc to close). aria-pressed semantics on the chip group MUST be preserved (the chip the manager picks reflects aria-pressed=true). The S key continues to cycle through states (cycleStateFilter logic stays).

queue.symptom: × clear-owner button (lines 260-273) commits owner=null on mouseDown with tabIndex=-1 — invisible to keyboard, irreversible by mouse. For a PM on a 500-feature plan, an accidental clear erases the audit trail of who owned the stage.
queue.root_cause: Button uses `onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void commitUser(null); }}` with no confirm phase and tabIndex=-1, so keyboard users cannot reach it and mouse users cannot recover.
queue.change: Two-click confirm — first click transforms × into a 'Confirm clear' pill for ~2 seconds; second click commits owner=null. Implementation hint: add a local `useState<'idle' | 'pending'>('idle')`, transition to 'pending' on first click, auto-revert to 'idle' after ~2000ms via setTimeout (cleanup on unmount), commit owner=null only when clicked-while-pending. Make the pill keyboard-accessible (tabIndex=0, respond to Enter/Space). Stanza explicitly picks option (a); option (b) (post-clear undo) is rejected: 'Pick (a) — consistent with the rest of the page's inline-first vocabulary.'

queue.symptom: InlineOwnerPicker (~354 LOC) and StagePerformerCombobox (~340 LOC) solve overlapping problems (both pick a roster member for a stage). The avatarTone switch is duplicated verbatim across three sites: GanttFeatureTrackBand.tsx:13-26, GanttTrackStageRow.tsx:31-44, GanttStageSubRow.tsx:55-66. Canonical roleToAvatarTone already exists at src/common/ds/Avatar/role-tone.ts:10.

queue.change: (a) Replace each local `function avatarTone(...)` definition in GanttFeatureTrackBand.tsx, GanttTrackStageRow.tsx, GanttStageSubRow.tsx with `import { roleToAvatarTone } from 'src/common/ds/Avatar/role-tone'` (or the equivalent alias) and use it at the call sites. Three definitions deleted, three imports added. (b) Either (i) collapse InlineOwnerPicker + StagePerformerCombobox into one combobox with a `mode` prop (`'inlineCell' | 'tableCell'`) — preferred — OR (ii) document in code with a substantive comment (≥40 chars) at the top of one of the two files why they must remain separate. Target a 300–500 LOC reduction across the FE folder. Both halves of the fix are required (compound, not options).

queue.symptom: The dotted underline on inline-edit cells (lines 43-46) only paints on :hover. A PM reading 'Lead: Anna' cannot tell from the canvas alone that 'Anna' is editable; they must hover to find out. Undermines the keyboard-first/discoverability principle in PRODUCT.md.
queue.root_cause: Affordance-on-hover only; no rest-state CSS rule for .inline-cell__input.
queue.change: Add a 1px rest-state dotted bottom-border at ~30% opacity that strengthens to 100% on hover. One CSS rule. Concrete shape: `.inline-cell__input { border-block-end: 1px dotted color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); }` — and the existing :hover rule continues to override at full opacity. Token-faithful (no literal rgb/hex).

queue.symptom: Line 161: `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%);` violates the 'no #000' / OKLCH-only doctrine in DESIGN.md.
queue.root_cause: Literal rgb expression slipped past review.
queue.change: Replace with: `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--text) 30%, transparent);` to match the file's prevailing OKLCH-token pattern.
